messages:
emily: Quick Q — where do I find logs/traces for the new 'zenith-gen' route? Need p95 + 5xx counts for EU region for a post-mortem.

raj: Try Dashboards -> Routes -> zenith-gen (prod: eu). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/routes/zenith-gen?env=prod&region=eu

kevin: There's a saved search I created: 'ops/zenith-gen-eu-errors' — it filters by org:acme model:zenith route:gen region:eu status:[500..599]. Want me to pin it to the org view?

emily: @kevin yes please pin, and can you paste the query? I'll add to the postmortem doc.

kevin: ```
org:acme AND model:zenith AND route:gen AND region:eu AND status_code:>=500
| stats count() by status_code, span=1m
| where count() > 10
```

oncall-bot: Alert: zenith-gen-eu-5xx threshold breached at 2024-05-21T14:03Z — firing to #oncall (p1) :rotating_light:

raj: For alert tuning, lower noise by excluding 502 spikes: add `status_code != 502` or raise to `count > 50 over 5m` depending on traffic. Also consider tagging on `kv_cache_miss:true` for regen storms.

nicole: Pinned the saved search to org view and created a dashboard panel. Panel link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/panels/98765

emily: Thanks all — added links to postmortem. @raj can you open a quick PR to adjust alert threshold to 5m/50? Small description in ops/alerts repo would be great.

raj: On it. PR in a few mins — will include rationale and rollback note. Ping me if the panel needs a different time range.

kevin: :thumbsup: also exported query as share token: https://logsearch.redwood.ai/s/abc123 (expires in 7d)

emily: cool — closing loop here. If anyone wants a saved preset for future hunts we can add to /savedqueries library.
